blogs.title: Building my 2nd AI Chat Bot for our Airbnb Unit in Taguig
blogs.excerpt: In this blog post, I share my experience building a second AI chat bot for our Airbnb unit in Taguig. I discuss the tools and technologies I used, the challenges I faced, and the results of implementing the chat bot to enhance guest communication and satisfaction.

blogs.title: AWS Health to Jira Automation Workflow
blogs.excerpt: By automatically monitoring emails from health@aws.com, the system uses an AI model (LiteLLM with Anthropic Claude) to filter out routine background noise and identify truly actionable events.

blogs.title: How Auto Scaling Rescued a Philippine Government Agency's Over-Budget DTR App
blogs.excerpt: Discover how migrating a legacy government attendance system to AWS elasticity chopped idle-capacity costs while surviving massive twice-a-day traffic spikes.
